plan-button-row.title: Button row (Mac order)
plan-button-row.note: Only lays out buttons; for one button look take button. For the remove control take remove-control.

level-date-input.title: Date picker for a level
level-date-input.note: The date field of a level's popover in the value graph; the year rules are in date-rules. The Levels line's own dates are in value-levels-line. Plan.Value

remove-control.title: Remove control (red minus button)
remove-control.note: Deletes the row it sits in; it calls the host and writes nothing itself. For a plain button take button.

card-group.title: Card group (framed group of a card)
card-group.note: Needs the card-mode provider; for a plain card surface take card. The person card's linked-person rows are not in it.

plan-card-facts.title: Plan card facts (sources, meters, status lines)
plan-card-facts.note: Facts on the record itself; Value child records are value-card-model, links plan-links-model. Not the older spec-card-facts.

value-card-model.title: Value card model
value-card-model.note: Pure read and fact builders for the Value and Development Resource card; writes are value-card-write, the screen is value-card. Plan.Value, Plan.DevelopmentResource

value-graph-geometry.title: Value graph geometry (axes, date ticks, bands)
value-graph-geometry.note: Math only; the drawn graph is value-graph.

type-picture.title: Type picture
type-picture.note: Draws a type's picture or nothing; as a button that opens the definition take type-term-popover.

plan-kinds.title: Plan card types and their lines
plan-kinds.note: Which lines each Plan type shows, in order; the drawn card is plan-card. Plan.Type

plan-links-model.title: Plan card links model (Part of, Solution of)
plan-links-model.note: Pure link reading and loop checks; the link lines on screen are plan-tag-links.

plan-impacts-model.title: Impacts model (Solution on Value and Resource)
plan-impacts-model.note: Pure; the Impacts table on screen is plan-impacts.

qualifier-value-picker.title: Qualifier value picker
qualifier-value-picker.note: Picks the value(s) of one Scale qualifier; to edit the qualifiers themselves take value-qualifiers-line. Plan.Value

sortable-tree.title: Sortable tree (drag and keyboard reorder)
sortable-tree.note: Reports drops and writes nothing; needs @dnd-kit/core 6.3.1. The Description editor that uses it is description-parts-view.

plan-stakeholders-model.title: Stakeholders, Authority and Resource Owner model
plan-stakeholders-model.note: Pure reading and constraint person rules; the lines on screen are plan-stakeholder-lines. Plan.DevelopmentResource

description-parts-model.title: Description parts model (Keyword parts)
description-parts-model.note: Parsing, tree, ordering and removal plans; the editor on screen is description-parts-view.

record-picker.title: Record picker (search and pick)
record-picker.note: The caller decides what is searched; for a GilbVeda type take type-chooser, for a Plan record by tag take plan-tag-picker.

entity-ref-value.title: Record reference shown by name
entity-ref-value.note: Shows a stored link as the record's name; includes GilbApp's refDisplayName (not entity-ref's).

field-row.title: Field row (click-to-edit text)
field-row.note: Text only, on a card with card-mode; for a controlled form field take field-control.

type-term-popover.title: Type definition popover
type-term-popover.note: Opens a type's definition and ontology link; to choose a type take type-chooser, for the picture alone take type-picture.

type-chooser.title: Type chooser (GilbVeda type search)
type-chooser.note: Search and pick a GilbVeda type; the Plan card's Type line is plan-type-field. For records take record-picker.

plan-type-field.title: Type field of a Plan card
plan-type-field.note: One GilbVeda type as a chip with the Replace question; the first line Type · Level · Version is plan-type-level-version. Plan.Type

plan-type-level-version.title: Type · Level · Version line
plan-type-level-version.note: The first line of every Plan card with the level chooser; the project's levels come from project-levels.

project-levels.title: Project levels (Business, Product, Solution)
project-levels.note: Reads and adds a project's levels for the level chooser; the line that shows them is plan-type-level-version.

plan-source.title: Source control (who said it)
plan-source.note: statedBy, derivedFrom or words for one Plan line; writes only through onCommit.

plan-tag-picker.title: Plan record picker by tag
plan-tag-picker.note: Links to a Plan record by its tag or creates one; the link lines themselves are plan-tag-links.

plan-stakeholder-lines.title: Stakeholder, Authority and Resource Owner lines
plan-stakeholder-lines.note: Three Plan card lines in one unit; the pure rules are plan-stakeholders-model. Plan.DevelopmentResource

plan-tag-links.title: Link lines (Part of, Sub-functions, Solution of)
plan-tag-links.note: Seven link lines of a Plan card; the picker alone is plan-tag-picker, the pure model plan-links-model.

plan-impacts.title: Impacts table of a Solution
plan-impacts.note: Impacts on Values and Development Resources; the pure model is plan-impacts-model.

help-doc.title: Help page building blocks
help-doc.note: Layout, sections, steps and notes of an in-app help page; the Description help is description-help.

description-help.title: Description help panel
description-help.note: Help for writing a Description in Keyword parts; built from help-doc.

description-parts-view.title: Description editor (Keyword parts)
description-parts-view.note: Draws and edits the Description as a tree of parts; the pure model is description-parts-model, the drag tree sortable-tree.

value-graph.title: Value graph (Scale arrow and timeline)
value-graph.note: Draws and drags levels and never writes; the card line that holds it is value-illustration, the math value-graph-geometry. Plan.Value

value-card-write.title: Value card write layer
value-card-write.note: Saves levels, qualifiers, meters and Scale as child records; a read-only Value card does not need it. Plan.Value

value-scale-line.title: Scale line of a Value card
value-scale-line.note: Unit, rate, context and direction; writes through onChange. The qualifiers of the Scale are value-qualifiers-line. Plan.Value

value-qualifiers-line.title: Qualifiers line of a Value card
value-qualifiers-line.note: Edits the Scale qualifiers and their options; to pick a qualifier's value take qualifier-value-picker. Plan.Value

value-endpoint-line.title: Endpoint line of a Value card
value-endpoint-line.note: Subject and Reference types with pictures; writes through onChange. Plan.Value

value-meters-line.title: Meters line of a Value card
value-meters-line.note: Each Meter with its Human, AI and Instrument lines; writes through onChange. Plan.Value

value-levels-line.title: Levels line of a Value card (Goal, Budget)
value-levels-line.note: Every level with number, date, qualifiers and source; the drawn graph is value-graph. Plan.Value, Plan.DevelopmentResource

value-illustration.title: Illustration line of a Value card
value-illustration.note: The card line around value-graph; for the graph alone take value-graph. Plan.Value

plan-card.title: Plan card engine
plan-card.note: One engine for all four Plan cards; to start from one card take function-card, solution-card, value-card or resource-card.

function-card.title: Function card
function-card.note: The whole card for a Function or Function Constraint; for one line take its line unit. Built on plan-card.

solution-card.title: Solution card
solution-card.note: The whole card for a Solution or Solution Constraint; for one line take its line unit. Built on plan-card.

value-card.title: Value card
value-card.note: The whole Value card; for one line take its line unit (value-scale-line, value-levels-line …). Built on plan-card. Plan.Value

resource-card.title: Development Resource card
resource-card.note: The whole Development Resource card (Budget, Resource Owner); it is the Value card for t:Resource. Built on plan-card. Plan.DevelopmentResource

plan-card-hosts-gilbplatform.title: Plan card host for GilbPlatform (one provider for all four Plan cards)
plan-card-hosts-gilbplatform.note: Take this to draw the Function, Solution, Value and Development Resource cards on GilbPlatform with no host object written: one provider sets the origins and the session. It is not a card; the cards are function-card, solution-card, value-card and resource-card, built on plan-card. For one host alone use its factories. Plan.Value, Plan.DevelopmentResource

own-card.title: Own card finder (my profile card in a vault)
own-card.note: Finds the signed-in person's own card (my profile card, self card) in a vault by hard identity: the derived id or the vault's profile pointer, never by name or email. It reads through a transport you inject. To only compute the card's id and address with no read take self-card; to use the finding as the source of what a person writes take plan-self-source.

plan-self-source.title: Own card as the source of what a person writes (useSelfSource)
plan-self-source.note: The signed-in person's own card as the a:statedBy source of a Plan line: finds it once in the landing vault and answers its address or nothing. Never by email or display name. The finding itself is own-card; the id alone is self-card. Plan.Value, Plan.DevelopmentResource

stakeholder-kinds.title: Stakeholder kinds and their words (read from the master)
stakeholder-kinds.note: Which kinds of record may be a stakeholder (Person, Organization and the like) and their labels, read from the GilbVeda master, kept across sessions and shared per page; "not known yet" is never "none". For the lines on a Plan card take plan-stakeholder-lines; for its rules take plan-stakeholders-model. Plan.DevelopmentResource

lws-records.title: Record client (read, create, change, retype one record)
lws-records.note: The typed client for one record in a vault over the platform's record interface (record client): read, create, patch and retype, with the typed errors a refused write throws. For a list of records take lws-vault-sets or record-sync; for a screen's list with create, retype and delete take plan-record-hooks; for the credential it signs with see lws-session-bridge.

lws-vault-sets.title: Vault sets (what a vault holds: pages, find, text search)
lws-vault-sets.note: Asks a vault what it holds: a page of its records or files, a find by attribute, a text search, with a cap on requests in flight. It reads and writes no single record; for one record take lws-records. For only what changed since a stored position take record-sync.

record-sync.title: Record list and change feed (what changed since a position)
record-sync.note: A vault's typed record list and only what changed in it since a stored position, through the authenticated fetch the host injects. No React and no credential of its own. For one record take lws-records; for a text search or attribute find take lws-vault-sets; for the screen hooks take plan-record-hooks.

plan-record-hooks.title: Record list hooks (scrolling list; create, retype, delete)
plan-record-hooks.note: React hooks for a scrolling list of a vault's records and the three changes a person makes (create, retype, delete): each shown at once, written in the background, the cache put back on error. Needs a query client. For a single read or write without React take lws-records; the cache it uses is record-cache-kit.

lws-relations.title: Relation client (write, read, end a relation)
lws-relations.note: Links between two records only; for one record take lws-records, for a page or find take lws-vault-sets. Not a sign-in and not a cache of relations.

platform-fetch.title: Signed platform fetch
platform-fetch.note: Only the fetch that signs each call; the sign-in is signin, the credential seam is lws-session-bridge. It holds no credential and does not retry.

main-tag.title: Main tag of a record (read, cached)
main-tag.note: Only reads a main tag, never writes one; the name shown for a record is entity-ref-value or record-cache-kit. For the tag calls themselves take tag-client.

ontology-reads.title: Ontology term reads (definition, picture, search)
ontology-reads.note: Public reads with no credential and no writes; it has no built-in ontology host. For a vault record take lws-records.

online-stakeholder-card.title: Online stakeholder card (person with no record)
online-stakeholder-card.note: Read-only card of a person from the holder's circles who has no record, with an offer to make the holder's own card; for a card that merges both take one-card, for the Plan cards take plan-card.

stakeholder-card-hosts-gilbplatform.title: Stakeholder card host for GilbPlatform
stakeholder-card-hosts-gilbplatform.note: The ready-made GilbPlatform host for the Stakeholder entry card, so it draws, reads and adds with no host object written; for the Plan cards take plan-card-hosts-gilbplatform.

reachable-vaults.title: Vaults the signed-in person can reach
reachable-vaults.note: Reads the reachable vaults with names, parents and landing flag, and decorates the session's vault set; it does not search or page records, for that take lws-vault-sets.

contact-rows.title: Contact rows (Email, Phone, Social, Skills)
contact-rows.note: Edits any number of Email, Phone, Social and Skills rows of a person; it is not the stakeholder's Relations or Contact-preferences fields, which are stakeholder-set-fields.

stakeholder-set-fields.title: Stakeholder Relations and Contact-preferences fields
stakeholder-set-fields.note: Draws and edits only the Relations and Contact-preferences fields from the ontology's field set; for Email, Phone and Social rows take contact-rows.

org-employees.title: Organization employees (inline and searchable sheet)
org-employees.note: Lists an organization's employees inline and in a searchable sheet; for its parent and units take org-hierarchy, for its logo take org-mark.

org-hierarchy.title: Organization parent and units
org-hierarchy.note: Shows and edits an organization's parent organization and units; for its employees take org-employees, for its logo take org-mark.

org-mark.title: Organization logo
org-mark.note: Draws an organization's logo from a bounded file fetch; for a person's or vault's photo take vault-profile-photo or grantee-face.

stakeholder-find.title: Find existing people by name as you type
stakeholder-find.note: Looks up the holder's existing records of a name while typing, before a new one is made; it creates nothing, for that take person-create.

kind-relation.title: Tie a person to a kind of contact
kind-relation.note: Writes and ends the tie between a person and a kind of contact, with race guards; for any other link between records take lws-relations.

person-create.title: Create a person record
person-create.note: Makes a person record in a named vault, finding candidate people first; for a general record write take lws-records, and for a lookup alone take stakeholder-find.

vault-profile-photo.title: Vault profile photo
vault-profile-photo.note: Finds and loads a vault's own profile photo and makes the vault's own card when it has none; for a photo another person shares with the viewer take grantee-face.

grantee-face.title: Photo another person shares with you
grantee-face.note: Loads the profile photo another person shares with the viewer; for a vault's own photo take vault-profile-photo.

one-card.title: Merged stakeholder card (theirs and yours)
one-card.note: Draws one merged card per person, the holder's rows and the person's rows in one frame; for a person with no record take online-stakeholder-card.

stakeholder-list-reader.title: Stakeholders list reader
stakeholder-list-reader.note: Reads a holder's stakeholders, records and online people into one deduplicated list with names and photos, within a request budget; it draws nothing.

birthday-picker.title: Birthday picker
birthday-picker.note: Picks a birthday from day, month and an optional year with no free text; for a date at a level take level-date-input.

online-card.title: Link a record to the person's online card
online-card.note: Finds, links, unlinks and refreshes the link between a holder's record of a person and that person's own online card; for the card itself take online-stakeholder-card.

stakeholder-record-card.title: Stakeholder record card (a holder's own record of a person)
stakeholder-record-card.note: The whole card of a person the holder keeps a record of, with Edit, +, the groups in their order, autosave, languages, skills, interests, employment and the link to their online card; for a person with no record take online-stakeholder-card, and to mount it on GilbPlatform take stakeholder-record-card-host-gilbplatform.

stakeholder-record-card-host-gilbplatfor.title: Stakeholder record card host for GilbPlatform
stakeholder-record-card-host-gilbplatfor.note: The ready-made GilbPlatform host for the Stakeholder record card, so it draws, reads and saves with no host object written; mount it inside the provider of stakeholder-card-hosts-gilbplatform. For the online card's host take stakeholder-card-hosts-gilbplatform.

language-section.title: Languages group of a person card (name and flag)
language-section.note: The Languages group of a held person card: the languages by name and flag, add, flag, remove, mark the contact language, make private; it is part of stakeholder-record-card, so take that for the whole card.

skill-rows.title: Skills section with a held note under each skill
skill-rows.note: A person card's Skills section with the held note, who added it and the private or shared switch under each picked skill; for the plain Skills rows with no notes take contact-rows.

skill-picker-sheet.title: Skill picker sheet (search the catalogue, set a depth)
skill-picker-sheet.note: A bottom sheet that searches the live skill catalogue and lets the holder pick a skill with its depth; for the Skills section that draws it take skill-rows.

interest-rows.title: Interests section with a held note under each interest
interest-rows.note: A person card's Interests: each with its note, who added it and who sees it, add from the catalogue and remove; for Skills take skill-rows.

held-notes.title: Held notes (what a holder keeps about someone, private or shared)
held-notes.note: Reads and writes the notes a person keeps about someone in their own vault, private or shared with that person, one claim per note; for the rows that draw them take skill-rows or interest-rows.

employment-rows.title: Employment section of a person record
employment-rows.note: The whole Employment section of a person card over the record's employment edges, in the card's modes (read, edit, add, remove); for the state alone take employments-state, for one framed group take employment-card.

employment-card.title: Employment card (a person's employments as a framed group)
employment-card.note: One person's employments as a framed group: company, role dates, titles; add, edit and remove, over an editor you hand in; for the section already wired to a record take employment-rows.

employments-state.title: Employments state (load, add, edit, remove, each write queued)
employments-state.note: A React hook that reads a person record's employments, adds, edits and removes them one write at a time, with no drawing; for the section that draws them take employment-rows.

company-search.title: Company box (type a name, pick an organization record)
company-search.note: The company box of an employment: type a name, pick a matching organization record or use the name as typed, and it says which vault it searched; for the whole Employment section take employment-rows.
